about: Studio cards: one entry per API workflow. inputs[] maps form fields to node inputs (see backend/docker/handler.py for the input types). models and custom_nodes are derived by backend/tools/manifest.py sync.

profiles.title: All workflows
profiles.summary: Every card, including the NVIDIA RTX upscalers (NVIDIA's free proprietary SDK).

profiles.title: 100% open weights
profiles.summary: Open-weights models and open-source code only: the NVIDIA RTX cards are hidden, and RTX Video Super Resolution inside other workflows becomes a lanczos resize.

workflows.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein
workflows.summary: Black Forest Labs' small FLUX 3: sharp photoreal text to image in 15 steps.

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.hint: Describe the whole picture: medium, scene, light, subjects

workflows.license_note: Gated on Hugging Face: accept the FLUX Kommunity License on the ComfyUI repo https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy (accepting it on the main flux-3-image-klein page is not enough), then set HF_TOKEN.

workflows.title: SCAIL-2 Motion Transfer (loopable)

workflows.title: SolarRenderer: blocks to cinematic video
workflows.summary: Turn a rough structure video (grey boxes, depth, skeletons, a segmentation, even a sketch) into a finished 6.6 s clip on MiniMax H3, in four steps; a first frame and a detailed prompt set the look.

inputs.label: Structure video
inputs.hint: the motion, layout and camera to follow, 24 fps; up to 158 frames are used

inputs.label: First frame
inputs.hint: frame 0 of the structure video, already in the final look (recommended)

inputs.label: Summary
inputs.hint: one paragraph: who does what, and how the camera moves

inputs.label: Detailed description
inputs.hint: 350-500 words: the look first, then the shot in order. Describe what the camera turns to: the render falls back to the raw blocks where the prompt is silent

inputs.label: H3 model
inputs.hint: Singularity V2: a community fine-tune of H3 (sharper action, faces and camera moves); the official H3 otherwise

workflows.license_note: SolarRenderer's LoRAs are under the MiniMax H3 Community License, like MiniMax H3 itself.
